messages.content: I’ll build a day-ahead book that combines evening energy sales with reserve revenue, while keeping the required end-of-day charge. I’ll check feasibility before committing, then manage the remaining watches as conditions change.

ERCOT has issued a hot-weather notice. Regulation deployments have also changed the battery’s charge and used more discharge allowance than planned. I’ll adjust the remaining energy schedule to keep the fixed reserve awards backed.
